_doc: Level modifiers: rolled per level by the generator once unlocked (balance.json -> modifiers). Shown on the HUD and at the start of the level.

elite.name: ELITES
elite.desc: Some foes are elite: tougher, bigger and richer.

double_gates.name: DOUBLE GATES
double_gates.desc: Every gate effect is doubled. Good and bad.

boss_enrage.name: BOSS ENRAGE
boss_enrage.desc: The boss attacks faster and uses every phase.

cursed_only.name: CURSED
cursed_only.desc: Every gate along the way is a curse.
